name: How should I prepare a room before drywall taping and finishing begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare a room before drywall taping and finishing begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear personal belongings from the work area, cover adjacent flooring, and ensure the heating or cooling system maintains a consistent temperature between 55 and 70 degrees. Drywall dust easily spreads through HVAC vents, so sealing return registers is a prudent step. If your project involves plumbing or electrical rough-ins—such as during a kitchen, bathroom, or basement renovation—confirm all rough inspections and wire runs are finalized before joints are taped, avoiding the need to reopen finished walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear furniture, protect floors, seal HVAC vents, maintain indoor temperatures above 55 degrees, and ensure all electrical and plumbing rough-ins are inspected.
